MatchedObjectDescriptor.SubAgency: Defense Health Agency Indo-Pacific Market Guam
MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary: Who May Apply: US Citizens In order to qualify, you must meet the experience requirements described below. Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student; social). You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. Your resume must clearly describe your relevant experience; if qualifying based on education, your transcripts will be required as part of your application. Additional information about transcripts is in this document. Specialized Experience: One year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-07 grade level in the Federal service which includes coding medical diagnosis and procedures utilizing current coding guidelines; conducting audits of medical records coding for accuracy and develop programs for orienting and training medical staff in basic coding techniques. This definition of specialized experience is typical of work performed at the next lower grade/level position in the federal service (GS-06).

Details.JobSummary: About the Position: This position is with the Defense Health Agency, Naval Hospital Guam, Directorate of Administration, Patient Administration, Agana Height, Guam. This is a Direct Hire Solicitation
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: As an integrated health care system, the Defense Health Agency delivers healthcare services across the Department of Defense and enables combat support to the Joint Force as a strategic partner. Through a robust healthcare delivery system, and a dedicated team of inspired professionals, the Agency ensures the worldwide delivery of medical, dental, and pharmacy programs to more than 9.5 million uniformed service members, retirees, and their families, by improving health and building readiness Anytime, Anywhere-Always.
